I have proposed several dates and times for this meeting. I trust that you will find one suitable and respond promptly. The details of the proposed meeting are as follows:

Date: [proposed date]
Time: [proposed time]
Location: [proposed location]

I look forward to your prompt response and hope that we can resolve this matter amicably.

Yours sincerely,

[Your Name]
